name: Photo with Hotspots
description: Select a photo and add hotspot product links to it.

attribute_definitions.name: Container class
attribute_definitions.description: Class(es) to add to the hotspot container for spacing, background color, etc.

attribute_definitions.name: Tooltip class
attribute_definitions.description: Class(es) to add to the tooltip container for spacing, background colors, fonts, etc.

attribute_definitions.name: Custom Image Alt Text
attribute_definitions.description: Add alternative text for image, default is an empty string. See following to better understand what to write: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/images.html#alt

attribute_definitions.name: Hotspot 1 Image
attribute_definitions.description: Upload an image and place a hotspot.

attribute_definitions.name: Hotspot 1 primary text
attribute_definitions.description: Optional primary text.

attribute_definitions.name: Hotspot 1 primary text class
attribute_definitions.description: Class(es) to add to the primary text for styling purposes, e.g. 'h4'.

attribute_definitions.name: Hotspot 1 secondary text
attribute_definitions.description: Optional additional text placed below the primary text.

attribute_definitions.name: Hotspot 1 secondary text class
attribute_definitions.description: Additional class(es) to add to the secondary text for styling purposes, e.g. 'text--gray'.

attribute_definitions.name: Hotspot 1 Product ID
attribute_definitions.description: The ID of the product to be displayed for Hotspot 1.

attribute_definitions.name: Hotspot 1 Theme
attribute_definitions.description: Set the theme to help with visibility of the hotspot. Default is light
